The folder focusses on creation of the setup so that image can be created from raw data. Please note to run the program enter the correct file path of header file and raw file so that it can run smoothly.  
A copy of the header file and a raw file is attached to the folder so the format and use of both can be understood.This is derived from “75-Angle Phantom” dataset  
For changes reference, please view test 2, where we used a different dataset(PICMUS) for testing. It also contains a copy of the header and raw file of the different dataset.  
It is to be noted that all formats are in “.mat” file v7.3 version or more.  
(All rights of the header file and raw file are as according to their respective publisher. It is used here for educational purposes and non-profit works.)

The image created matches their reference whose link is [https\://arxiv.org/abs/2404.14188](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.14188).
